mintAuthority.summary: EUROe was a Finnish EMI-licensed euro EMT solely issued by Membrane Finance (later Paxos Issuance Europe), now in redemption-only wind-down. MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are both held by EOAs; no multisig migration occurred despite earlier plans. UUPS proxy with no timelock.

controls.label: Membrane/Paxos MINTER_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295054, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE=0x9f2df0fe…, 0x74424510108a8ad9aa6a5b506048948e6a16706b) = true; eth_getCode on that address returned no bytecode (EOA). RoleGranted events scanned from creation block 16432602; no RoleRevoked for this address was found. The minter role was never migrated to a multisig.

controls.label: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA (UUPS upgrade authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295054, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=0x00…, 0xd5731b8c97b61cdede6c612ec963b3f86af0c3f7) = true; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). The UUPS proxy has no separate proxy-admin slot (empty). PROXYOWNER_ROLE was self-assigned to the proxy contract at creation (pattern for UUPS self-administration). No multisig migration occurred.

review.evidence: Verified at Ethereum block 25295054. UUPS proxy at 0x820802fa8a99901f52e39acd21177b0be6ee2974; impl 0x85c427aa5605c242ff693c1e45b8641a9cb8279d (EUROe contract, verified). MINTER_ROLE active holder: EOA 0x74424510 (hasRole confirmed, no revoke). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE: EOA 0xd5731b8c (hasRole confirmed). No multisig migration ever occurred despite earlier plans; both key roles remain EOA-held. Token is in redemption-only wind-down; total supply 20510 EUROe as of block 25295054, no minting events in last 50k blocks. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: EOA mint and UUPS-admin paths are unbounded, FIN-FSA EMI authorization is prudential supervision, and the redemption notice provides no recurring whole-supply reconciliation.
